title: 100 km2, headwater Mesh, Outlet 27, floor 200 m, river target 200 m
deck: Controlled outlet-27 comparison where the river refinement still targets 200 m and the global mesh floor is also lowered to 200 m, so the local river field can actually be expressed.
summary: This case is the paired run used to explain the visible river-refinement difference on outlet 27. It keeps the same outlet, the same river input, the same geology interfaces, and the same river refinement target as the 340 m-floor case. The only intended change is that `min_size` is lowered here to 200 m, matching the requested river target, so the gallery can show the refinement that was previously clipped by the global floor.
what_it_shows: How outlet 27 looks once the global floor no longer blocks the requested `200 m` river refinement.
That the river geometry is unchanged relative to the 340 m-floor case, so the visible difference comes from mesh sizing only.
How many extra cells appear when the local river corridor is allowed to reach the requested 200 m size.
case_setup: Same input linework as the paired comparison case: 48 river lines, 95 active geology-interface lines.
River refinement request kept at `interface_size = 200 m` over `interface_distance = 610 m`.
Global floor lowered to `min_size = 200 m`, matching the requested river target.

key_parameters: The comparison is controlled: the river target stays at `200 m` in both cases, and the river linework count stays at `48` input lines and `473` embedded river curves.
Here the global floor is also `200 m`, so the river family field can reach the size it requests near the constrained river curves.
The resulting bundle is denser than the 340 m-floor run because more of the local river corridor is actually resolved.
how_to_read: Compare this page directly against the paired `floor 340 m, target 200 m` case; nearly all visible differences should be read as consequences of the lower global floor.
The important reading is qualitative first: small branches should look more clearly supported by nearby mesh edges once the floor matches the river target.
Then read the metrics: this run reaches more nodes and cells because the requested river refinement is no longer clipped.
next_steps: Open :doc:`the paired 340 m-floor case </capability_gallery/cases/mesh_headwater_100km2_outlet_27_geology_rivers_buffer30_floor340_target200>` to see the same outlet with the river target still requested but partially blocked by the global floor.
